subject: POC kickoff: payload curation, redaction, and load-test timetable

To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.ai>
Cc: sales_ops@ledgerx.com
Date: Wed, 24 Jun 2026 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: POC kickoff timing and payload questions

Hi Evelyn,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — the team was impressed with the latency numbers. We'd like to lock in a formal POC kickoff and a working session where we:
  - run through a suite of our test prompts,
  - validate routing behavior for user-tiered traffic, and
  - do a short load test ramp to measure sustained throughput.

We have a 2-hour window the week of Jul 6 that works for the core group (Product + ML + Infra). Can your team run a hands-on session where we actually load our sample payloads and exercise redaction?

I attached the initial sample CSV export (anonymized at the column level) and a brief note on the fields we consider PII. If you need different formatting (JSON vs CSV) let us know.

High-level goals for the session: clear checklist to sign off on inference routing, ensure KV cache behavior is correct for conversational workloads, and a smoke load test up to ~150 concurrent streams with short sequences.

Best,
Anna
Head of AI, LedgerX

Attachments: sample_payloads_v1.csv (CSV, 120 KB), redaction_guidelines_v1.pdf (PDF, 45 KB)

Hi Anna — thanks, this looks like a great starting point. A few quick clarifications so we can scope the hands-on session precisely: 

1) Format & size: CSV is fine. For the load ramp we'll need ~1.2M tokens total across the test set; can you confirm approximate average token/row or share a small JSON sample?

2) Redaction: we'll follow your redaction_guidelines_v1.pdf but please confirm whether you can remove whole-text PII or if you prefer Redwood's in-session masking so you can keep original values for post-test analysis.

3) Routing & tenants: will the test include 3 logical user tiers (free / standard / premium)? If yes, please indicate target qps per tier so Karthik can map to autoscaling policies.

Proposed times: Tue Jul 7 10:00-12:00 PT or Thu Jul 9 13:00-15:00 PT. If those don't work we can push week of Jul 13.

We'll prepare a lightweight runbook (poc-runbook-light.md) with the test plan, ramp steps, and rollback triggers. I'll loop in Monica for calendar ops and post-session evaluation.

Next steps: please reply with (A) preferred slot, (B) sample row (JSON) or avg tokens/row, (C) confirmation on redaction approach.

Cheers,
Evelyn Hart
Solutions Architect, Redwood Inference
(p) 415-555-0123

Quick operational notes from CS side:

- Pre-reads: please upload the sample row (JSON) to the shared Drive link before Mon Jul 5 so we can pre-validate ingestion schemas. Link: https://drive.redwood.ai/rdw/RDW-2893/poc-checklist

- Routing tests: Karthik will run two routing scenarios during the session: weighted routing (65/25/10) and priority fallback. To map autoscaler knobs we need expected sustained QPS per tier and the longest expected sequence length in tokens. If you expect long conversations, tell us the 95th percentile sequence length.

- Load test plan: warmup 5 minutes at 10% target, then 5-minute steps to target (30%, 60%, 100%), hold at 100% for 10 minutes. We'll capture latency percentiles and token cost.

- Compliance: if LedgerX requires us to retain logs outside your VPC for debugging, we will mark the data as ephemeral and share retention window options. Please indicate preferences.

I'll send a calendar invite once we confirm slot and provide the minimal runbook.

Thanks,
Monica Patel
Customer Success Manager, Redwood Inference

Evelyn / Monica — quick update: thanks for the detailed plan. Two items: (1) we have a conflicting board review on Jul 7; can we move to Thu Jul 15 09:00-11:00 PT instead? (2) I attached a 10-row JSON sample (converted from CSV) and a short doc that clarifies which columns are "tokenizable" text vs structured metadata.

Answers inline: avg tokens/row ~85 tokens; 95th pct sequence length ~420 tokens; yes, three tiers (free/standard/premium) with target sustained QPS: free 5 qps, standard 20 qps, premium 50 qps (total target ~75 qps). We prefer LedgerX to keep original values internally for analysis; redaction at ingest is fine for Redwood to mask in-session if needed. Retention: ledgerx prefers logs retained for 7 days in our (LedgerX) S3 bucket; Redwood should not retain outside except ephemeral debug traces kept for 48 hours.

Attachments: sample_row_10.json (JSON, 4 KB), tokenization_map.pdf (PDF, 12 KB)

On the calendar: Jul 15 works for our PM and infra lead — please send the updated invite.

Best,
Anna
